Package com.hiface.sdk.detection

Class FaceDetectionConfig

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.detection.FaceDetectionConfig
public final class FaceDetectionConfig extends java.lang.Object
Immutable output settings for one live detection call.

Specifies what the application receives from processFrame, separately from the analysis required by active flows. The SDK may perform additional analysis for a flow. For example, rejecting multiple faces still checks for a second face even if this request returns only one.
